scope.description: Baseline audit of current application source, tests, frontend, API, infrastructure, deployment workflows/scripts, and directly related documentation/configuration.
excluded: Historical .copilot-tracking plans, research, and prior review records as primary review targets

changeBrief: The working tree is clean, so this is a human-approved whole-repository baseline audit rather than a diff review. The system combines a React workspace, an authenticated TypeScript API, paid lyric/chat and Speech capabilities, SQLite/PostgreSQL persistence, MCP tools, and Azure deployment automation. Review attention is on cross-boundary behavior, stale or conflicting integration paths, and validation gaps.

diff.reason: The working tree is clean on main and the user confirmed a whole-repository baseline audit.

changeRiskEvidence.evidence: Baseline review spans 57 application, test, infrastructure, workflow, and deployment-script files, with related product and operator documentation.
The reviewed system includes authentication, authorization, paid-provider budgets, persistence, deployment credentials, and networked infrastructure.
Git history is available; recent commits show tightly coupled feature, deployment, authorization, and UX integration work through 2026-11-19.
The repository has API tests for auth, web routes, storage, deployment, and creative flows, plus a React App test and root test scripts.
No coverage configuration or coverage report was found in the package scripts/configuration.
Operator documentation describes backups, SQLite import, and explicit reset gates, but deployment and data cutover span private Azure services and require maintenance coordination.

depthRationale: Human-confirmed after reviewing the broad system boundary and critical persistence, identity, paid-provider, and deployment surfaces.
